verdict.rationale: gstack skills are plain SKILL.md files in a public repo, installed by git-clone-and-copy or symlinked from a local checkout into .claude/skills/. Because of this install model, the instructions a skill adds can be read before and after installing. However, gstack documents no dedicated preview, listing or audit feature, and inspection relies on the open-file design rather than a review capability. Missing for 10: a documented pre-install listing of the files and scripts a skill adds, a documented post-install file inventory or review command, explicit coverage of bundled scripts and binaries (e.g. the compiled $B CLI), and hands-on corroboration that every installed file is inspectable.
